messages:
tara: Heads-up: planning a rolling reboot + NIC firmware patch in us-east1 next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Targeting cohort 'flux-pool-7' (~120 GPUs). Expect transient egress ratecap hits while we rotate racks.
liam: Is this the microcode+kernel combo? any thermal concerns?
lara: @tara can you confirm whether Dedicated tenants get drained first or after hosted? need to update support playbook.
tara: Yes, microcode + NIC fw + a small kernel backport. We'll cordon by rack, evict pods, then reboot. Dedicated first for isolation; hosted capacity will be shifted to us-west warm pools.
kai: Will KV cache seed be preserved? last time we had cold-cache regressions for large seq.
tara: We'll run kv-seed after each rack comes back online. Plan: 10m cordon -> evict -> 30m reboot -> kv-seed + warmup (~20m). Sequence: rack A -> B -> C.
liam: Cost question: moving hosted to us-west burst adds egress + preemptible infra. Rough estimate?
marco: Quick estimate: egress ~1.2TB, cross-region egress cost ~ $120, and spot backfill ~ $350 for the window. Total ~ $470. tagging billing now.
ops-oncall: ops FYI: I'll be on-call for the window. If latency > 200ms tail for >5m we abort and rollback.
sre-bot: AUTO: inject canary traffic to rack-A after reboot (5% traffic) at +15m. Watchdog will escalate on 3% error increase.
kai: Can we add a short fallback to lower-capacity quantized model instead of full failover? cheaper than cross-region shift for some tenants.
tara: Good call. We'll add policy: for non-SLA tenants, route to quantized variant in-region; for SLA customers, shift to us-west. I'll add to rollout config.
liam: Ops checklist? need runbook pointer.
tara: Runbook snippet:```bash
# cordon + drain
redwood infra cordon --rack flux-pool-7-rackA
redwood infra drain --rack flux-pool-7-rackA --grace 600
# reboot
redwood infra reboot --rack flux-pool-7-rackA --firmware nic-v2.3.1 --kernel 5.10.102
# kv seed
redwood infra kv-seed --pool flux-pool-7-rackA --parallel 8
```
marco: I'll prep billing tag and cost center. cs-team: please hold a short customer email for hosts with <SLA>.
ops-oncall: Rolling window approved. I'll monitor egress and queue depth. post any perf regressions to this thread. :thumbsup:
tara: Thanks. I'll post final start ETA 24h before. If anyone sees conflict with other windows ping me.
liam: ack. I'll add a quick perf test after rack C to verify tail lat and throughput.
marco: tagging cost in the maintenance ticket: MAINT-4821.
ops-oncall: minor note: one of rackB's BMC sensors flapped yesterday (ticket 1872). we should skip rackB first and move it to last in sequence unless BMC is validated.
tara: Good catch — moving order to A -> C -> B. Updating runbook.
liam: :eyes: thanks.
